result:
The maximum is achieved when each pair of circles meets in two distinct points and no three circles share a common point. With 4 circles there are C(4,2) = 6 pairs, each contributing at most 2 intersection points, for an upper bound of 12. This bound is attainable (e.g., four circles of equal radius centered at the vertices of a small square, radius chosen so every pair intersects in two points, with no three concurrent), so the maximum is 12.

VERDICT: ACCEPT
